text:
taylor: Quick FYI 1 - onboarding call showed the node sample CLI spamming WARNs on startup and exposing full request IDs and emails in logs. folks hit this running `./devx sample-app --auth local`.
taylor: Minimal repro: mac, node 20, default env. logs: 
```
WARN 2026-03-22T09:45:02Z AuthRetry: auth failed, retrying, req_id=3b1a9f7c-4e2d-4a9c-8a1b-1234567890ab, user_email=test+dev@acme.com
WARN 2026-03-22T09:45:03Z AuthRetry: auth failed, retrying, req_id=3b1a9f7c-4e2d-4a9c-8a1b-1234567890ab, user_email=test+dev@acme.com
```

taylor: Two issues: (1) expected local retries are noisy at WARN, (2) PII (email) and full request ids leaked before our redaction layer attaches masked ids.
sam: Is this limited to the node sample-app or other templates?
taylor: Node sample-app only so far. Go and Python templates don't show the full id leaks.
arya: Sounds like an init-order problem. The otel hook that maps headers->ctx (and performs masking) runs after the logger middleware, so the logger prints raw header values. seen similar in an internal webhook handler.
arya: Proposed app-level quickfix: swap initialization order in `sample-app/src/index.js` to run otel before logger/enricher. That gets redaction attached early.
mike: Long-term we should make the SDK robust to init order. The logger enrich function can defensively mask req.headers['x-request-id'] if present (e.g., mask all but last 8 chars). Go SDK does this; node didn't due to earlier shim.
jess: Also why are retries WARN by default? that makes new devs worry. For local dev I think AuthRetry should be INFO. We bumped level in prod to highlight auth flaps but forgot templates.
eng-bot: CI: node/sample-app tests: telemetry:redaction timed out on master. flaky test noted.
sam: Action items: 1) SDK defensive redact helper (node + go + py parity) 2) sample-app template change (init order) 3) AuthRetry level change for dev templates to INFO 4) add e2e that asserts no raw emails/reqids in logs during boot. I'll file the tracking ticket.
sam: Assigning: @mike -> sdk redact util & tests, @taylor -> sample-app PR + test, @jess -> docs blurb for onboarding.
taylor: I'll submit sample-app PR today with the init-order change and a unit test that checks logger output doesn't include full req_id or email.
mike: Starting node-sdk PR: add `redactRequestId()` util, update logger.enrich to mask header-first if no otel ctx. will add tests for header-only, otel-only, and both. will coordinate with go-sdk.
jess: I'll update the onboarding guide and add `DEVX_TELEMETRY_MODE=quiet` suggestion for local. also add note about expected INFO vs WARN.
arya: Also add a small defensive redaction util to shared telemetry helpers repo so we can share across languages (docs + algorithm).
sam: Thanks team. prioritize SDK util first to avoid fragile app fixes. follow-on: update templates, sample-app, docs. :thumbsup:
